profile_text.body:
Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing Company Limited (TSMC) is the world's dedicated semiconductor foundry, founded in 1987 and headquartered in Hsinchu, Taiwan. The company describes itself as supporting a global ecosystem of customers and partners with what it characterizes as the industry's leading process technology and portfolio of design enablement solutions. TSMC's stated mission centers on accelerating innovation in integrated circuit design and product applications, contributing to both global IC innovation and Taiwan's economy.

The held facts show no AI products tracked, litigation cases, MCP servers, or SEC filings in the dataset. TSMC is a public company trading under the ticker TSM.
